gates.locked_prompt: Barred from within the Guildmaster's Reliquary

pickups.label: Claim the Rite of the Golden Comb

plaques.text:
CHARTER OF THE AMBER FOUNDRY

Let no tallow of flesh or beast enter these kettles. Here the Guild boils only the comb of the Golden Skeps, gathered from the cliff-meadows while the noon was whole.

Four votives in the South Cloister keep the Reliquary unbarred.

THE GOLDEN SKEPS

The sun-bees do not sting the hand that smells of prayer. In glory their hives hum with remembered noon; in ruin the comb sets harder than bronze.

THE GUILDMASTER'S RELIQUARY

Here rests the Censer-Mace of the First Chandler — flanged in vat-bronze, cored with an undying coal of royal wax. Above the western stair stands the High Scriptorium where the tithe-ledgers were sealed.

OSSUARY OF THE FIRST CHANDLERS

Those who tended the Queen-Skeps were not buried in earth; their shrouds were steeped seven times in clarified comb until time could find no seam to enter. With them rests the Rite of the Golden Comb.

EDICT OF REFUSAL

By hand of Malakor, Sovereign Chandler: The seventh wagon from the Hour Palace shall return empty. What light remains in the Queen-Combs belongs to the Parish and the bees. Let the Sovereign come down and skim the vats himself.

THE CLIFF-STAIR TO THE SOVEREIGN APIARY

Beyond this postern climbs the cliff-path to the Cloister of the Golden Comb, where Matriarch Aurelia and her blind sisters tended the living hives in the salt wind above the sea.
